# LINE-style blowing-kiss sticker GIF

<a href="https://x.com/Gorden_Sun/status/2097508341992083824"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/tweet_video_thumb/HRvYtOcbAAAztHg.jpg" width="640" alt="LINE-style blowing-kiss sticker GIF — @Gorden_Sun — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Generate sixteen connected bust poses with fixed Chinese lettering, then assemble a GIF.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A character reference image.
- An environment that can split frames and export a GIF.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Generate a set of individual frames for a cartoon-style (LINE sticker aesthetic) half-body GIF animation based on the character in the image; ensure the headwear and hairstyle are accurate.
Generate 16 small images arranged in a 4x4 grid. These 16 images should represent a continuous, sequential animation (“飞吻”) that forms a complete, seamless loop with fluid, realistic movement; the final frame should transition smoothly back to the first. Each of the 16 images must include the Chinese text (“爱你哦”) rendered in a font that complements the image style. Leave sufficient whitespace between the 16 images to facilitate later cropping, ensuring no image extends beyond its designated area. Do not copy the original image exactly; use only the figure from the image. Use a solid white background and do not draw dividing lines. Image aspect ratio: 1:1.

After generating the image, crop it into individual square panels—minimizing whitespace during cropping—and then compile them into an animated GIF.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-line-bust-sticker-gif?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--line-bust-sticker-gif)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- The image text “爱你哦” is intentionally preserved in every translation.
- The author requests frame generation followed by cutting and GIF assembly. GIF export is a separate processing step, not an image-only model capability.

### View source wording

```text
为我生成图中角色的卡通Line风格的半身像GIF表情包每一帧的图片，注意头饰和发型要正确。
使用 4行x4列 布局共生成16个小图片。16个小图片为“飞吻”动画的连贯的拆分动作，使用这16张可以组成一个完整的、循环动画，动作流畅逼真，最后一帧应流畅地循环回到第一帧。16张图片里都使用跟图片搭配的字体写着汉字“爱你哦”。16个小图片之间需要有足够留白方便后续切割，每张图片都不要超出自己的区域。
注意不要原图复制，只是使用图片里的人物。背景为纯白色，不要画分割线。图片比例1：1

生成图片后再切分成一张张正方形的小图，切分时尽量切掉更多的空白，然后合成GIF动图
```
